label: Gargoyle A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact original stone gargoyle monster: compact lean muscular biped with cool slate-gray and blue-violet stony hide, pale gray mottled highlights across the face, upper chest, shoulders and front thighs, and deep navy-purple shadows. Narrow elongated goat-like reptilian muzzle with pointed chin, stern brow, two tiny bright red eyes, pointed side ears and two thick dark-gray horns curling backward in tight arcs beside the crown. Long bent arms with thin bony clawed fingers, muscular haunches, bent knees and narrow ankles ending in long splayed clawed toes, not hooves. A very thin long dark-gray tail extends from the lower back and ends in a small flattened spade; match its curve in each native view. Two separate bat wings grow from the shoulder blades, dark charcoal-gray skeletal struts with little hooked top joints and rich dark leaf-green thin membranes, mottled vein-like stony texture and deeply scalloped lower margins with long thin wing finger tips. Preserve the native folded or spread wing outline, individual finger struts and body occlusions in every frame. It is a carved living stone beast, with no clothing, armor, accessories, weapon, hair or added anatomy. Preserve native head size, slender waist, large thighs, long hands and wing proportions. Only the green wing membranes are recolorable; stone body, horns, claws, tail and small red eyes retain their native colors. No added glow, particles, rubble, pedestal or environment.
